summary: More 2.19 deprecations: use truthy/falsy tests over bool coercion, cache.base module, v2_on_any and v1 callbacks, templated conditionals, and config options ACTION_WARNINGS, DEFAULT_ALLOW_UNSAFE_LOOKUPS, DEFAULT_JINJA2_NATIVE, DEFAULT_NULL_REPRESENTATION and DEFAULT_UNDEFINED_VAR_BEHAVIOR which no longer have effect.
questions: Does DEFAULT_JINJA2_NATIVE do anything in ansible-core 2.19?
Can I still use {{ }} in when conditions?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.19 deprecations (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `bool` filter: use documented values or the `truthy`/`falsy` tests.
- `ansible.plugins.cache.base` → `ansible.plugins.cache`.
- Callbacks: `v2_on_any` and the v1 API (non-`v2_` methods) are deprecated.
- Conditionals with `{{`/`{%` should be plain expressions, unless the whole value is one template resolving to a trusted string expression.
- No-effect config options: `ACTION_WARNINGS`, `DEFAULT_ALLOW_UNSAFE_LOOKUPS`, `DEFAULT_JINJA2_NATIVE` (native is the only mode), `DEFAULT_NULL_REPRESENTATION`, `DEFAULT_UNDEFINED_VAR_BEHAVIOR` (undefined variables are always an error where unexpected).
